name: Brightstall
summary: A sales dashboard for a small brand selling online, in its own shop and to other stores
about: An eight-page sales dashboard with top pill navigation, shown with a handmade pottery brand in Multan. A goal orbit fills one ring per channel toward the month's goal, a stacked stream shows the three channels over time, and pages cover sales, products, customers, stockists with reorder rhythms, goals and reports. Good for small shops, makers and e-commerce brands.
how: Use the pill tabs at the top; on a phone the menu button opens them.
Record a sale for Online, Own shop or Stockists: stock drops, the rings fill and a channel that reaches its goal bursts into sparkles.
On Goals, drag a slider to change a channel's goal; the orbit and the month's pace chart follow as you move it, then save.
Switch 7D, 30D or 12M on the sales stream and in Reports to morph the charts.
Stockists show how long since their last order against their usual rhythm; send a reminder or create a wholesale order.
Open a sale to mark it paid, send a receipt or refund it; Settings resets the demo data and switches the theme.
